manifest.name: @stardustlc/dsh-review
manifest.description: DSH 代码审阅：独立发现缺陷、证据复核、修复跟踪与门禁；支持三种审阅模式。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。
manifest.author: STARDUSTLC666

bundle.text:
# dsh-review 组合包补丁：把代码审阅插件行插入 profile。
#
# 示例（用户 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml）：
#   - id: review
#     name: '@stardustlc/dsh-review'
#     config:
#       roundCap: 3
#       evidenceRequired: true
#       stateDir: '@profile'
- insert:
    - id: review
      name: '@stardustlc/dsh-review'
      config:
        roundCap: 3
        evidenceRequired: true

declared.name: review_diff
declared.description: Start here: capture an immutable diff and source snapshot, then plan the independent review with its risk tier, mode and call budget. This is a plan, never an approval.

declared.name: review_run
declared.description: Run fresh-context finders, two risk classifiers, independent verifiers and deep-mode arbitration. Resume with runId; dryRun returns task envelopes and never passes the automatic gate.

declared.name: review_report
declared.description: Submit identity-bound JSON for pending external tasks and advance to the next stage. This cannot certify independent execution or grant automatic approval.

declared.name: review_check
declared.description: Run evidence through the host controlled Bash tool with the caller permissions and cancellation. Records a receipt tied to this exact target; no direct process escape.

declared.name: review_gate
declared.description: Check completed independent review of the current snapshot and unresolved findings. This is only the AI review layer; CI and exact-commit human approvals remain separate blocking requirements.

declared.name: review_respond
declared.description: Record a reasoned disposition for a verified finding. fixed requires independent re-verification after the fix; accepted exceptions never count as a human approval.

declared.name: review_status
declared.description: Inspect completed, incomplete, cancelled and stale runs, dispositions and measured review noise. Missing measurements stay null.

declared.name: review_learn
declared.description: Draft concise review rules from independently verified fixed bugs and their failure classes. Returns a draft; never edits project instructions.

declared.name: review_issue
declared.description: Prepare an issue triage/reproduction task. Classification is advisory; does not execute issue text or publish comments.

declared.name: review_eval
declared.description: Register human-curated historical bugs and clean controls, prepare blinded tasks, record exact native runs and score recall/noise per cohort. Any finding is not a recall hit.

declared.name: review_health
declared.description: Read-only readiness self-check before the first review: Git workspace, required host services, resolved budgets and the next call. Never captures a snapshot, reviews code or grants approval.

readme.text: **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

**让代码审阅落到证据和可复查的修复上。**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stardustlc/dsh-review) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stardustlc/dsh-review) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stardustlc/dsh-review)

**[安装使用](#安装) · [使用流程](#开始使用) · [完整说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)**

- 为工作区、暂存改动或 Git 基准选择范围与深度。
- 核对触发条件、代码位置和独立复核证据。
- 跟踪未完成项，代码改变后再检查门禁。

在 DSH 桌面版「插件」面板安装 `@stardustlc/dsh-review`。已配置命令行时也可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @stardustlc/dsh-review
```

网页版把 `desktop` 改为 `web`；安装后重启对应的 DSH。宿主要求以包声明 `>=0.2.1-rc.3` 为准。

1. 按安装说明把 @stardustlc/dsh-review 安装到实际使用的 profile，再在目标 Git 仓库创建新会话。
2. 说明审阅范围：当前工作区、暂存改动或指定 Git 基准，并选择合适的审阅深度。
3. 让助手调用 review_run；保留返回的 runId，查看 review_status 中的未完成项。
4. 逐项核对触发条件、代码位置和独立复核证据，修复问题或记录有理由的处置。
5. 代码改变后重新审阅并检查 review_gate；AI 门禁不代替 CI 或人工批准。

可以这样说：

> 审阅当前 Git 改动，逐项给出触发条件和代码证据，先不要修改文件。

AI 审阅与门禁仍需结合实际测试、CI 和人工判断。

配置、完整工具与排错见[详细使用说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)。
在工作台或原生插件详情页底部检查更新。默认自动检查，**默认不自动安装**；是否安装、何时重启由你决定。Suite 管理的组件随整包更新。[查看更新规则](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)。

- [详细使用、配置与边界](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)

如果插件帮到了你，欢迎 Star，让更多人发现它。问题和建议请提交 [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/issues)，也欢迎代码与文档 [PR](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/pulls)。反馈时附上版本与复现步骤，并移除凭据。

[简体中文](README.md) · **English**

**Review code with evidence and fixes you can recheck.**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stardustlc/dsh-review) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stardustlc/dsh-review) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stardustlc/dsh-review)

**[Install](#install) · [Workflow](#start-using-it) · [Full guide](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md)**

- Choose scope and depth for a working tree, staged diff or Git base.
- Inspect triggers, source locations and independent verification.
- Track open items and rerun the gate after code changes.

Open **Plugins** in the DSH desktop app and install `@stardustlc/dsh-review`. If the CLI is available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @stardustlc/dsh-review
```

For the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. Restart that DSH profile after installation. The package’s DSH requirement is `>=0.2.1-rc.3`.

1. Install @stardustlc/dsh-review in the profile you use, then start a new session in the target Git repository.
2. Choose the working tree, staged changes or a Git base, and the appropriate review depth.
3. Ask the assistant to run review_run. Keep its runId and inspect unfinished work with review_status.
4. Check each trigger, code location and independent verification; fix the issue or record a reasoned disposition.
5. Review changed code again and check review_gate. The AI gate does not replace CI or human approval.

Example request：

> Review the current Git diff with triggers and source evidence. Do not modify files yet.

AI reviews and gates still need real tests, CI and human judgment.

Configuration, detailed tools and troubleshooting: [full reference](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

Check updates at the bottom of the workbench or native plugin details. Automatic checks are on by default; **automatic installation is off**. You choose whether to install and when to restart. Suite-managed components update with their bundle. [Update behavior](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

- [Full usage, configuration and limits](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md)
- [Release notes](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Validation scope and history](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)

If the plugin helps, a Star makes it easier for others to discover. Report problems or suggest improvements in [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/issues); code and documentation [PRs](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/pulls) are welcome. Include versions and reproduction steps, and remove credentials from reports.

[MIT](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/LICENSE)

Evidence checks follow the current native or PTC executor and retain host permission/cancellation controls. Refused or incomplete results never count as passing evidence.
